title: Merged cause lookup accepts unresolved control-trace references after HOST FAILURE events are moved to observer-trace
expected: SPEC397–409/418–423 and accepted plan step3 require exact recorded-cause coverage with real control-trace#globalordinal references, rejecting wrong references and contradictory evidence bindings.

source.detail: Merges control and observer record arrays, dropping ownership of the containing artifact.
Derives causes from the merged union rather than resolving the referenced control record.
Compares artifactRef with a constructed control path but does not verify that control.records actually contains that event.

reproducer: Generate genuine simulated privacy+four-cleanup failure report on current58f8fb6d. Confirm baseline accepted. Move the primary HOST FAILURE record (ordinal24), or all five at24/30/31/33/34, from control.records to observer.records without altering any event fields or union order. Recompute only the two trace artifact digests/sizes; keep failures bytes identical. assertEvidenceBindings accepts although one/all five ledger control references resolve to no record in their named artifact.
impact: Required audit/evidence binding can be contradictory while the verifier accepts. Terminal status remains INFRA_FAILURE/1. No demonstrated false PORT_OBSERVED, native escape or erroneous normal producer output. The old merged lookup weakness remains in the proposed scoped repair; this report does not claim it was newly introduced.
scopeReason: A direct wrong-reference/owning-artifact counterexample to LR02 and the accepted exactcontrol-trace reference invariant, not a new schema/capability requirement.
safeRemediationDirection: Resolve each non-null ledger reference against its actual owning control-trace record and reject invalid source/trace partitioning while preserving total-order comparison, cap/null suffix and valid partials. Direction only; no correction is authorized or performed.
